newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom says to buy $90 mln Dresser equipment.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom says to buy $90 mln Dresser equipment.

text.p: Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom said on Thursday that it would sign a contract valued at about $90 million with Dresser Industries Inc on Friday in Moscow for a compressor station for pumping high-pressure gas.
A Gazprom news release said the deal was backed by the Export-Import Bank of the United States.
Gazprom said the equipment would be used to increase output of condensate at the Yen-Yakha field in Novoi Urengoi near the far northern Yamal Peninsula, but gave no further details.
Gazprom's main, long-term capital expenditure project is its $40 billion Yamal-Europe scheme to increase Russian natural gas production and exports to Europe.
